Insurance – Fidelity Insurance – Respondent is a Collateral Management Company which stores commodities pledged by farmers, traders etc., in availing loan from lending banks and other institutions – In case of any loss of the pledged commodities, respondent is liable loss to the lending bank – Respondent took Fidelity Guarantee Insurance Policy from appellant-insurance company in respect of the pledged commodities stored in godowns – Three firms entered into agreements with respondent for storing commodities including urad and mentha oil –
